# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in a HyperMechane repository, please report it privately rather than opening a public issue.

Send security reports to:

**[security@hypermechane.com](mailto:security@hypermechane.com)**

Please include:

* A description of the vulnerability
* The affected repository or component
* Steps to reproduce the issue
* Potential impact
* Any relevant proof of concept or technical details

We will review valid reports and determine the appropriate response.

## Responsible Disclosure

Please allow reasonable time for investigation and remediation before publicly disclosing a security vulnerability.

We appreciate responsible security research that helps improve the security of HyperMechane projects.
